noEmailsDesc: Your inbox is currently empty. Click the refresh button to fetch the latest emails.
batchDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected emails? This action cannot be undone.
deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this email? This action cannot be undone.
deleteDescWithName: Are you sure you want to delete this email from {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
subject: Subject
logoutConfirm: Are you sure you want to logout?
clearCacheConfirmText: Are you sure you want to clear all cache data? This will delete offline files and temporary data. The app will re-download them on next startup.
editModeDesc: Enable to modify email recognition results
rulesDesc: Catch-all gateway: every email to this domain passes here first. Rules are evaluated by ascending priority; the first match wins. With no rules, the original behavior is kept.
rulesEmptyHint: E.g.: accept and archive proxy@gear4ai.com; forward *@gear4ai.com to Gmail; reject unknown addresses (whitelist).
ruleMatchExactInvalid: Exact match requires a full email address
ruleMatchDomainInvalid: Domain match requires a domain, e.g. gear4ai.com
forwardToHint: Targets must be verified destination addresses in Email Routing
categoriesDesc: AI auto-classifies incoming mail into enabled categories. Manage them below.
categoriesHint: Disabled categories are skipped by AI classification; deleting a category keeps existing emails as-is.
deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete category "{{name}}"? Existing emails keep their category label.
spoofWarningBody: This message claims to be from a gear4ai.com internal address, but mail sent by alle never flows back as inbound — it is forged. Do not click its links or use any verification codes in it; it was not auto-forwarded or pushed as a notification.
